title: Estimate part lookup no longer offers a part once it is inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ESTLOOK-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL ESTLOOK PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is still an estimate: it shows the "Estimate" pill and its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL ESTLOOK line") reads "Needs Approval" and holds no parts.
  • Before {Part-A} was set inactive, typing the start of its number in that line's part lookup offered it.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}.
  2. On {Line-1} open the line's ⋮ menu and click "Request part".
  3. Type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EST) in Part Number.
  4. Clear Part Number and type {Description-A}.
  5. Close the dialog with ×.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for {Part-A} is offered, neither as an inventory row nor as a "Part Library" row.
  • Step 4: Again no row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 5: {Line-1} still holds no parts and {Work-order-1} still shows the "Estimate" pill.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.2 (Once inactive: not offered; shown on a work order in the Estimate stage), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R2: “Part lookup on an estimate line does not return inactive parts.”
  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given GREASETUBE is inactive, when the user searches "GREASE" on a work order, estimate, part sale, purchase order or technician charge-out, then it is not offered, neither as an inventory part nor as a Part Library entry.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7, ListingQueryHandler: “Covers WO, estimate, tech charge-out (every device), PO, vendor-bill re-point, part sale”
